Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

correspond verb

write to each other

also correspondence, write to each other, exchange letters, keep up a correspondence, pen friend, pen pal

classical

Traupman 297
Sen. Ep. 38.1: hoc inter nōs epistulārum commercium frequentāre (Lewis & Short)
Vell. 2.65.1: commercia epistulārum

epistulārum commercium habēre cum (+ abl.)

correspond with, exchange letters with

Commercium is trade, and so any give and take: of letters, the correspondence itself (Traupman 297, epistulārum commercium, correspondence).

Other words

  • per litterās colloquī (cum aliquō) — talk with someone by letter

    colloquor, colloquī, collocūtus sum, deponent · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 1.7.1; Att. 6.1.24 (Lewis & Short, s.v. colloquor)

    Cicero’s way of putting it: a letter is a conversation with an absent friend.

  • scrībere ad aliquem — write to someone

    also used · classical

    For the single letter, and with crēbrō or saepe for a correspondence kept up (see contact).

Examples

  • tū, quaesō, crēbrō ad mē scrībe vel quod in buccam vēnerit

    please write to me often, even whatever comes into your headCic. Att. 7.10.1

  • hoc inter nōs epistulārum commercium frequentāre

    to keep up this exchange of letters between usSen. Ep. 38.1 (Lewis & Short)

See also contact, letter, post a letter, write.
